findings.detail: Rating 7/10: Cross-bundle evidence rejection is tested only through checked-gate. Existing checked-plant integration tests cover normal run/render behavior, but never render snapshot A's plant results through bundle B. Removing require_helper_bundle(value) from checked-plant.verified() would therefore escape these tests. With B differing only in README or reference contents, existing runner/input fingerprints still match, allowing plant evidence to be published through the wrong producing bundle.
findings.fix: Add a checked-plant snapshot integration case that produces results with A, confirms A can render them, then confirms B with changed reference contents refuses rendering without modifying ledger or status destinations.
findings.title: Uncited: Plant-result producer validation lacks a cross-bundle regression test.

strengths: Cache deletion and replacement tests synchronize with a running child and check subsequent rendering and verification.
Negative coverage includes content and mode tampering, symlinks, caller membership, inode replacement and partial context.
Review-result tests cover missing and incorrect provenance alongside legacy direct-invocation compatibility.
summary: Reviewed the canonical fixed-base changes, accompanying tests, plant manifests and relevant existing integration coverage, excluding generated copies. Coverage is substantial, with one Important gap in checked-plant producer validation. Tests and repository code were not executed, as required.
